newsitem.title: UK: Ghana cocoa purchases in 5th week behind last year.
newsitem.headline: Ghana cocoa purchases in 5th week behind last year.

text.p: Ghana cocoa purchases in the fifth week of the 1996/97 season ending November 14 were 22,432 tonnes compared with 28,178 in the corresponding week ending November 16 of the previous season.
Purchases in the fourth week of the current season were 19,308 tonnes.

The Ghana Cocoa Board said cumulative purchases at the end of the fifth period stood at 116,932 tonnes compared with a total 158,645 tonnes by November 16, 1995, which was the sixth week of the last campaign. Purchases in the fifth week of the year-earlier period were 42,947 tonnes with the cumulative figure standing at 130,467.
